high_variance.label: High model variance
high_variance.definition: At least one team in the game has a 6.0+ point range across active ratings systems: SP+, FPI, and TeamRankings.
high_variance.meaning: The active systems disagree strongly on at least one team. This is not automatically a bet, but it flags uncertainty and possible market/model opportunity.

medium_variance.label: Medium+ model variance
medium_variance.definition: At least one team in the game has a 3.0+ point range across SP+, FPI, and TeamRankings.
medium_variance.meaning: The active systems have meaningful disagreement.

coin_toss.label: Coin toss / near pick
coin_toss.definition: The production projected spread or current market spread is within 3.0 points of pick’em.
coin_toss.meaning: Small changes in assumptions, injuries, or market movement can flip the side.

coach_1h.label: Coach 1H support
coach_1h.definition: A team/coach has a positive first-half ATS support signal in the projected favorite/underdog role for this game.
coach_1h.threshold: period = 1H, is_applicable = true, games >= 7, avg ATS margin >= +2.5
coach_1h.meaning: Useful for first-half angle review, not standalone without market price.

coach_ats.label: Coach ATS support
coach_ats.definition: A team/coach has a positive full-game ATS support signal in the projected favorite/underdog role for this game.
coach_ats.threshold: period = Full Game, is_applicable = true, games >= 20, avg ATS margin >= +2.0
coach_ats.meaning: Supports side review when aligned with model/market edge.

rp_support.label: Returning production support
rp_support.definition: A returning-production matchup signal applies to the game, including offense returning production versus opponent defense returning production.
rp_support.threshold: RP support badge exists OR early-season returning-production signal exists. Badge source uses offense RP vs opponent defense RP gap.
rp_support.meaning: Early-season context only; the historical line-movement study did not validate a standalone RP signal.

travel_1h.label: Travel / 1H travel angle
travel_1h.definition: A 3+ timezone travel first-half signal applies, including road favorite start, road dog fade, or related 1H total angle.
travel_1h.threshold: Game appears in travel_1h_signals_2026.csv with 3+ timezone travel signal.
travel_1h.meaning: Flags potential early-game performance angle tied to travel/situation. The displayed 2024-25 samples have not passed a multi-season holdout test.

lookahead.label: Schedule spot: lookahead
lookahead.definition: Team may be in a lookahead or sandwich schedule spot.
lookahead.threshold: Schedule spot text/source contains lookahead or sandwich.
lookahead.meaning: Situational caution flag only until its ATS and totals performance passes a historical holdout test.

b2b_road.label: Schedule spot: b2b road
b2b_road.definition: Team is playing consecutive road games or a back-to-back road spot.
b2b_road.threshold: Schedule spot source contains b2b road, back-to-back road, consecutive road, or second straight road.
b2b_road.meaning: Situational fatigue/travel flag only until its ATS and totals performance passes a historical holdout test.

injury.label: Injury alert
injury.definition: A tracked injury/depth-chart signal exists for the game. Current preseason file has zero active injury alerts.
injury.meaning: Manual review required; impact depends on player/position importance and recency.

market_move.label: Market move / steam
market_move.definition: Current or future line-history signal showing meaningful market movement.
market_move.threshold: To be added after line-history normalization.
market_move.meaning: Can identify steam, stale numbers, or book disagreement.

pbp_away_dog_move.label: PBP opener move: away dog
pbp_away_dog_move.definition: A home favorite of at least three points has no positive opponent-adjusted success matchup advantage. Historically the closing spread moved toward the away underdog.
pbp_away_dog_move.threshold: Week 5+; home success matchup advantage <= -0.000181467; opening home spread <= -3
pbp_away_dog_move.meaning: Confirmed opener-to-close line-movement signal. The historical data does not identify a Sunday-to-Tuesday entry window. Review the away underdog at the opener and do not chase after the number has moved. This is not a proven ATS angle.

pbp_under_move.label: PBP opener move: under
pbp_under_move.definition: Low combined opponent-adjusted success and slow expected pace meet the frozen historical movement conditions.
pbp_under_move.threshold: Week 5+; combined success <= 0.931088; combined field position > -139.80758; expected pace >= 26.0139 sec/play
pbp_under_move.meaning: Confirmed opener-to-close line-movement signal. The historical data does not identify a Sunday-to-Tuesday entry window. Review the opening under and do not chase after the total falls. This is not a proven game-result angle.

cross_book_spread_outlier.label: Stale opener: spread
cross_book_spread_outlier.definition: One sportsbook's opening spread is the largest outlier from the cross-book opening median and is at least one point away.
cross_book_spread_outlier.threshold: At least 3 books; largest absolute spread deviation >= 1.0
cross_book_spread_outlier.meaning: Confirmed opener-to-close convergence signal. Shop the outlier book while its price remains available; the historical test does not yet establish a weekday cutoff. Not a game-outcome prediction.

cross_book_total_outlier.label: Stale opener: total
cross_book_total_outlier.definition: One sportsbook's opening total is the largest outlier from the cross-book opening median and is at least 1.5 points away.
cross_book_total_outlier.threshold: At least 3 books; largest absolute total deviation >= 1.5
cross_book_total_outlier.meaning: Confirmed opener-to-close convergence signal. Shop the outlier book while its price remains available; the historical test does not yet establish a weekday cutoff. Not a game-outcome prediction.

postgame_spread_repricing.label: Postgame market repricing: spread
postgame_spread_repricing.definition: A completed game's score and prior closing spread imply that the market is likely to upgrade or downgrade the team in its next matchup.
postgame_spread_repricing.threshold: Production threshold pending calibration against the first available 2026 next-game line.
postgame_spread_repricing.meaning: Predicts the direction of the team's next market valuation; it becomes actionable only when the first available next-game line has not already incorporated the expected change.
postgame_spread_repricing.evidence_status: Validated direction in 2024 and untouched 2025 holdout; production pending

postgame_total_repricing.label: Postgame market repricing: total
postgame_total_repricing.definition: Both teams' prior scoring surprises and garbage-time-filtered PBP predict the next game's closing-total innovation relative to rolling market-implied offense and defense ratings.
postgame_total_repricing.threshold: Production threshold pending calibration against the first available 2026 next-game total.
postgame_total_repricing.meaning: Designed to identify an early next-game total that has not yet incorporated the expected market repricing. This predicts movement toward the eventual market close, not the game result.
